snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies - PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies is available to play NOW on PC.

Become operant Hershel Wilk: a brilliant but tormented operant on a desperate assignment. Pick up the pieces of your broken network, untangle a bloody web of intrigue at the End of History, and prove yourself on the big stage or blow it all up – again.

ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies is now available for $39.99 on Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG, and will release on PlayStation®5 (PS5®) later this year. It will also be Steam Deck Verified and launch on GeForce NOW directly upon release.
